annotationRationale: Equal travel distances lead to a single linear equation using time equals distance divided by speed. Solving it requires fractional coefficients and consistent time units.
sourceMethod: Follows the official equation d/17+d/5=44/60, with the fraction combination and solution shown explicitly.

review.mathCheck: Equal distances give d(1/17+1/5)=44/60, hence d=17/6 kilometers. The cycling and walking times are 10 and 34 minutes. Rounding the walking distance gives 2.8 kilometers, choice C.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, independently worded adaptation of official solution 7's equal-distance time equation. The expanded fraction arithmetic and rounding are correct and sufficient for AMC 10.
review.annotationCheck: cnm_045 and cnm_p111 appropriately assess equation modeling and the travel relationship. cnm_044 supports the denominator equation, although the solution combines fractions rather than explicitly clearing denominators. cnm_p062 supports conversion; nearest-tenth rounding is routine background.
